corrections.issue: Babbage qualifies the result: slippage was 'effectively close to zero compared to previous years in a relative sense' after running the method for just over a year, not zero in absolute terms; he also notes the approach was first used on the sister financial-instruments strategy several years earlier with great success and rolled out to the alternative commodity program at the start of last year.
corrections.fix: After just over a year of passive, risk-budgeted execution, last year's slippage bill was much lower than in earlier years ('effectively close to zero' in a relative sense), helped by not crossing the spread and by invisible savings when the model changes its target before the order is done; the method was proven first on the sister financial strategy and rolled out to AQA at the start of last year.

completeness_estimate: 0.82 - first reader captured the full argument chain (structural market selection, alternativeness, trend quality, curve position, capacity, execution framework and costs, client positioning) accurately; missed supporting reasoning and caveats: fundamental versus measured diversification, capacity scaling with commodity volatility, the factor themes accessible, furnace-type clusters, long/short symmetry exceptions, Liberation Day insulation, the non-discretionary clarification, the multi-year drawdown, the CPI-goods inflation mechanism and the client top-up use
